subject: Former Wang Boqun residence, southern garden loggia

findings.two_orthophotos: The 2019-02-24 and 2025-04-07 roof images show the central rounded porch between two narrow side lobes. At both dates the two inward shoulders and central front roof apex intersect owner 3286 in the frozen far geometry and the 14.9 m roof in the original detailed city mesh.
findings.other_mapped_geometry: 2019 visual apron-front point intersects feature 1915, 16.2 m. The 2025 point at the apparent apron front is in the gap between the original features. Elevated architecture, tree cover and inter-image parallax prevent assigning a sufficiently precise common ground-level cut here.
findings.scope: Three central garden arches, five upper windows and the two stairs remain suitable for an independent exhibit. Adding the whole porch into the ordinary city without selectively replacing the embedded part would leave the old solid across the new openings. A finer survey must locate its rear cut and the garden-level boundary before an integrated placement can be verified.
